text: Generator protection: differential (87G), stator earth fault 100 % (64G), loss of excitation (40), negative sequence (46), reverse power (32), overexcitation V/Hz (24), overvoltage and undervoltage (59/27), overfrequency and underfrequency (81), inadvertent energisation (50/27), out-of-step (78), rotor earth fault (64R), backup impedance (21) and breaker failure, per IEEE C37.102. Generator and GSU overall differential (87GT) is applied in addition to 87G.
